answer: The defence here is jury selection by sortition from staked pool: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. Cloning 554 keys multiplies the price 554-fold: 54292 POA locked, or 7202 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. The zenith sits in the mechanism itself, the kernel sits in the price of faking it, and the trellis sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
